__
 
• A**preposition**is a word or group of words used before a noun, pronoun, or phrase to show direction, time, place, location, or to introduce an object.

 
 
• ​**Example: **"at", "in", "on", "upon" etc.​
 
 
 
• ​The preposition**'in'**is used to indicate location, to specify day, month, or year, to indicate color, shape, or size.
 
 
• ​Here in this sentence**'in'**is used to indicate location.*example:__ "__Water is **in **the container"​__*
 
 
 
• ​Therefore, We will use**'in'**to fill in the blank.

 

**The correct sentence will be:***​"__Dubai is like an oasis__*__***in***__*__the middle of a desert__".*

__
 
• Hence,** option 3**is the correct answer.​​​

​

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 __"Water is in the container"​__
 
 
 
• ​Therefore, We will use'in'to fill in the blank.

​इसलिए सही वाक्य होगा: *​"__Dubai is like an oasis __*__*in *__*__the middle of a desert__".*

questions.question:
Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.

Much villagers attended the feast hosted by the village panchayat.
questions.solution:
The error is in 'Much villagers' 

***__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect and has an error of **determiners**.
 
• Here** 'Many villagers'** should be used instead of **'Much villagers'**
 
• **'Much' **is uncountable.__
 __
 
• **Example:** There is too **much** food at home for us. *{ here we cannot count food }
 
 
 
• **'Many' **is countable.__
 __
 
• ​__**Example: ***There are **many **girls in the classroom.*{ here we can count girls }​
 
 

**The correct sentence will be:** ***'****__**Many'** villagers attended the fest hosted by the village panchayat.__* 

__
 
• Hence, option 3 is the correct answer.

 

* **Hinglish__**

__
 
• दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरणिक रूप से गलत है और इसमें 'determiners ' की ​ त्रुटि है I
 
• यहां 'Much villagers' के बजाय 'Many villagers' इस्तेमाल किया जाना चाहिए I
 
• 'Much' अगणनीय है।
 
 
• **उदाहरण: **There is too much food at home for us. *{ यहाँ हम भोजन की गिनती नहीं कर सकते }
 
 
 
• 'Many' गणनीय है I
 
 
• उदाहरण: *There are many girls in the classroom.*{ यहाँ हम लड़कियों की गिनती कर सकते हैं }
 
 

**सही वाक्य होगा: ***'**Many' villagers attended the fest hosted by the village panchayat.__* 

__
 
• अत: विकल्प 3 सही उत्तर है।

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **Confusion Points__** 

In the given sentence, the word "**hosted**" is functioning as a past participle, which acts as an adjective modifying the noun "**fest**." In this case, there is no need to include "**was/were**" before "hosted" because the sentence is in the active voice and the verb "**hosted**" is describing the fest.

If we were to rephrase the sentence using the passive voice, we could say: "*The fest, which was hosted by the village panchayat, was attended by many villagers."*

In this revised sentence, "**was hosted**" is used to indicate the passive voice, and the verb "**attended**" is in the past tense to match the verb tense of "**was hosted."**

The priest's sermon had a calming ________ on everybody.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**effect**' 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is 'effect'.
 
• **'Effect' **means *a particular impression, or look someone wants to create and it is a noun.*
 
• In this sentence, the ***priest* **wants to create** an *impression or look.***
 
• ***Also, in this sentence, 'calming' is an adjective which is used in an attributive way i.e. 'a/an/the + adjective + noun.'***
 
• According to the above point **'effect'** is the correct option.

**The correct sentence is: ***The priest's sermon had a calming **effect **on everybody.*__

__
 
• Hence, option 2 is the correct answer.

*​*__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

__
 
• दिए गए रिक्त स्थान के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त शब्द 'effect' है I
 
• 'Effect' *का अर्थ है एक विशेष प्रभा है।*
 
• इस वाक्य में, पुजारी एक **छाप **या प्रभा बनाना चाहता है और यह एक संज्ञा है।
 
• साथ ही, इस वाक्य में, 'calming' एक विशेषण है जिसका प्रयोग गुणकारी तरीके से किया जाता है अर्थात 'a/an/the + विशेषण (adjective) + संज्ञा (noun)'।
 
• उपरोक्त बिंदु के अनुसार 'effect' सही विकल्प है।

**सही वाक्य है: ** *The priest's sermon had a calming effect on everybody.*__

__
 
• अत: विकल्प 2 सही उत्तर है।

⇒ 4.5712 + 8 - 2 = 35

⇒ 12.5712 - 2 = 35

⇒ 12.5712 - 2 = 35

⇒ 10.5712 ≠ 35

LHS ≠ RHS

Given equation : 8 × 4 - 7 + 8 ÷ 2 = 35

⇒ 8 - 4 × 7 + 8 ÷ 2 = 35

⇒ 8 - 4 × 7 + 4 = 35

⇒ 8 - 28 + 4 = 35

⇒ 12 - 28 = 35

⇒ - 16 ≠ 35

LHS ≠ RHS

⇒ 8 × 4 + 7 - 8 ÷ 2 = 35

⇒ 8 × 4 + 7 - 4 = 35

⇒ 32 + 7 - 4 = 35

**⇒ 35 = 35**

**LHS = RHS**

questions.question: The sum of five numbers A, B, C, D and E is 37.5. The average of A and B is 6, and the average of D and E is 9. The average of A, B and C is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

The **sum of all five numbers** A, B, C, D, and E is given as 37.5.

The **sum of D and E** is 2 × 9 = 18.

Subtract the sum of D and E from the total sum to find the **sum of A, B, and C**: 37.5 − 18 = 19.5.

The **average of A, B, and C** is the sum divided by 3: 19.5 ÷ 3 = 6.5.

**∴ The correct answer is 6.5.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sum of five numbers (A + B + C + D + E) = 37.5

Average of A and B = 6

Average of D and E = 9

**Formula Used:**

Sum = Average × Number of observations

Average = Sum ÷ Number of observations

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d61f9deff71744e67dd683b3cdab22a0b6566cab0c5d898c55c387c456b5feb3.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sum of A and B = 2 × 6 = 12

⇒ Sum of D and E = 2 × 9 = 18

⇒ Substitute these in the total sum equation: (A + B) + C + (D + E) = 37.5

⇒ 12 + C + 18 = 37.5

⇒ 30 + C = 37.5

⇒ C = 37.5 − 30 = 7.5

⇒ Sum of A, B, and C = (A + B) + C = 12 + 7.5 = 19.5

⇒ Average of A, B, and C = 19.5 ÷ 3 = 6.5

**∴ The correct answer is 6.5.**

**__Additional Information__**

Basic Average Formula

The average of n numbers is calculated as (Sum of all n numbers) ÷ n.

Relationship between Sum and Average

Sum of observations = Average × Number of observations. This is used to find individual components when the total is known.

Weighted Average

When combining groups, the combined average is (n₁ × Avg₁ + n₂ × Avg₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).</p

questions.question: Instead of dividing ₹3,910 among P, Q and R in the ratio (1)/(4):(1)/(5):(1)/(8), by mistake it was divided in the ratio 4 : 5 : 8. By how much did R gain in this transaction?
questions.solution:
Given: 

Sum to be divided = Rs. 3910

Right ratio = (1)/(4):(1)/(5):(1)/(8)

Wrong ratio = 4 : 5 : 8

Concept used:

Ratio Proportion

Calculation:

Mentioned right ratio 

⇒ (1)/(4):(1)/(5):(1)/(8)

⇒(1/4 × 40) : (1/5 × 40) : (1/8 × 40)

⇒ 10 : 8 : 5

Correct share of R = 5/(10 + 8 + 5) × 3910 = Rs. 850

Share that R got because of the mistake = 8/(4 + 5 + 8) × 3910 = Rs. 1840

Gain of R = (1840 - 850) = Rs. 990

**∴ By Rs. 990 R gained in this transaction. **

questions.question: Which of the following statements is NOT true about plateaus?

options.text: The Deccan plateau is one of the oldest plateaus in India.
A plateau is an elevated flat land.
Plateaus are rich in mineral deposits.
The Marwar plateau is the highest plateau in the world.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**The Marwar plateau is the highest plateau in the world.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

__
 
• A plateau is a flat-topped tableland.

 
 
• **Hence Statement 2 is correct.**
 
 
 
• Plateaus occur on every continent and take up a third of the Earth's land.
 
• They are one of the four major landforms, along with mountains, plains, and hills.
 
• Plateaus, like mountains, may be young or old.
 
• **The Deccan plateau in India is one of the oldest plateaus.**
 
 
• **Hence Statement 1 is correct.**
 
 
 
• Sometimes, a plateau is so eroded that it is broken up into smaller raised sections called Many outlier plateaus are composed of very old, dense rock formations.
 
• Iron ore and coal often are found in plateau outliers.
 
• **Plateaus are very useful because they are rich in mineral deposits. As a result, many of the mining areas in the world are located in the plateau areas**.
 
 
• **Hence Statement 3 is correct.**
 
 
 
• The largest and highest plateau in the world is the Tibetan Plateau,__ sometimes metaphorically described as the "roof of the world", which is still being formed by the collisions of the Indo-Australian and Eurasian tectonic plates.
 
 
• **Hence Statement 4 is incorrect.**
